## What changes for the user?

Describe the story and observable behavior. Link its issue if one exists.

## Design

Explain changed use-case boundaries and any new dependencies or patterns.

## Validation

- [ ] `mvn verify` passes
- [ ] Relevant normal, invalid-input and failure paths were checked
- [ ] No generated data, credentials or IDE files are included
- [ ] Documentation and screenshots reflect the final behavior
- [ ] The changes can be explained by the contributing team member

Reviewer: _team to assign_. Record actual review feedback; do not pre-check approval.
